# studio.hdr

`royal_esplanade_1k.hdr`, taken from the three.js repository's bundled example
textures:

    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r160/examples/textures/equirectangular/royal_esplanade_1k.hdr

1k equirectangular Radiance HDR, 1.67 MB. Originally from HDRI Haven, now
Polyhaven, published CC0. It is an interior with large soft windows, which is
why it works here: the windows act as the softboxes a product photographer
would use, and matte black film needs broad soft sources to show its form.

polyhaven.com is blocked by this machine's network policy, so it came via
GitHub instead. **Confirm the licence yourself before any of these renders go
out commercially** — CC0 is what it is published under, but that is a claim
worth checking at the source rather than taking from a build note.
